title: GET /tournaments/:id/prizes response
description: Who gets what, as the Prizes page has it, for the desk roles (like the standings it comes from). One table per prize list - the general one first unless the priority says otherwise, then the categories - each award with its place, player and amount. `configured` is false, with no tables, when no prize money is set or the event is a team event. `final` is false while rounds, results or postponed games are still to come: the list is provisional until then. Amounts are formatted by the server (`1 234.50 EUR`); a non-cash prize has an `item` and may have no amount.

paid.description: The total paid out, formatted; empty when not configured.

name.description: The category; null for the general table.

unclaimed.description: Places nobody was left to take.

place.description: "3", or "3-5" for places shared by players level on points.

amount.description: Formatted; empty for a prize without money.
